title: Create a short link
description:
Free. Creates https://widecast.ai/s/<ID> that redirects to `url` and counts every
open. Leave `custom_id` empty for a random 6-character ID (no 0 or O), or set
4-32 letters or digits (case-insensitive, stored in capitals). 409
`custom_id_taken` when the ID exists; 429 `rate_limited` after 10 new links per
account per hour. ⚠ Running creates a real link.

fields.name: url
fields.label: url (full http:// or https:// link, ≤ 2048 chars)

use_cases.title: 🔗 Short link with a random ID
use_cases.description: Only the long link. WideCast picks an easy-to-read ID such as K7QW2M. ⚠ Run creates a real link.

use_cases.title: 🏷️ Short link with your own ID
use_cases.description: Pick the ID yourself: letters and digits only. 'Sale2026' is saved as SALE2026. ⚠ Run creates a real link.
